patch.value: X.mean(axis=1) computes one mean per row, shape (n,). Broadcasting lines it up with the last axis (columns), which only works when n equals the number of columns, so the 4 x 4 result was already wrong. Use X.mean(axis=0).
axis=1 gives row means, shape (n,); they broadcast across columns only when n equals the column count, so the 4 x 4 output was wrong too. Use axis=0.
